# Audacity label tracks

One file per song, named `<song_id>.txt`, exported from Audacity with
**File > Export > Export Labels**. Each line is tab-separated:

```
<start_seconds>	<end_seconds>	<reference transcript for that span>
```

These files are committed because they hold only timestamps and short lyric
lines. They are what `src/carti_asr/data/segment.py` uses to cut clips from the
Demucs vocal stems.

Labeling conventions (keep these consistent across all songs):

- One label per line or phrase, at most 30 s (Whisper's window). Aim for 3 to 15 s.
- Transcribe what is **sung**, not what Genius says when they differ.
- Ad-libs: transcribe them in the label if they are clearly audible in the stem,
  and wrap them in parentheses, e.g. `(what)`. The normalizer can then score with
  or without ad-libs (`--drop-adlibs`).
- Spell non-standard words the same way every time (`finna`, `gon'`, `slatt`).
  Add any new ones to `src/carti_asr/eval/normalize.py: SPELLING_MAP`.
- Skip spans with overlapping features or heavy backing vocals.
